title: Bank Negara allocates RM2b for relief, recovery | The Star
text:
Bank Negara allocates RM2b for relief, recovery | The Star
KUALA LUMPUR: Bank Negara Malaysia (BNM) has announced an additional allocation of RM2 billion for the Targeted Relief and Recovery Facility (TRRF), as well as the establishment of a RM200 million Disaster Relief Facility (DRF) 2021.
In a statement today, BNM said the additional allocation brings the TRRF to a total of RM4 billion, and the facility is available until Dec 31,2021, or until full utilisation, whichever is earlier.
